attribution.note: Marcus quoting his own summer 2025 essay in his own post. He republishes it as his view, so these are his words.

semantics.note: Faithful. Dropping 'continue to' doesn't change the meaning. It is a plain present-tense observation with no hedge.

contract.note: 'Stable models of the world' is undefined. The plain reading (reliably tracking state, e.g. legal chess moves) uses Marcus's own example and is fair and ordinary. Taking summer 2025 as the target period fits the footnote.

evidence.note: Aug 2025 tournament of leading LLMs: illegal-move forfeits outnumbered checkmates in most first-round matches.
The same report names board visualization and legal moves as general LLM weaknesses in Aug 2025.
June 2025 informal but documented test: GPT-4o repeatedly lost track of piece positions.

One model avoided these failures on one day. That falls short of the contract's bar of reliable tracking across leading models. The packet labels it contradicts; I treat it as limited counterevidence.
Studies models trained for specific domains, not chat LLMs. Context only, despite its 'supports' label.

reviews.rationale: Under the fair plain reading, summer 2025 evidence shows leading LLMs often losing track of board state and making illegal moves. Grok 4's single good day does not show reliable tracking across leading models, so the contradiction condition is not met.

semantics.note: Faithful, and keeps the weaker 'contributed to'. The paragraph opens with 'Perhaps in part', but the sentence itself is firm.

contract.note: Requiring only a real contribution, not the sole cause, is fair. Reading 'survival of the nation' as national-security importance is a reasonable plain reading.

evidence.note: Shows the White House treating AI as vital to its power. It does not trace that belief to doomer advocacy.
The investor describing its own investment, with other stated reasons. It neither establishes nor rules out a doomer publicity effect.

reviews.rationale: The evidence shows endpoints (company funding and White House framing) but no record linking either to doomer advocacy. Other motives do not rule out a contribution. The packet does not settle the causal claim.
